Fox now says: don't listen to podcasters! They don't have fact-checking departments or any commitment to the truth and facts the way that we -- the professional journalists -- have.

They all sound like Ursula von der Leyen, Rachel Maddow and EU censors now.

Hilarious that many conservatives heralded podcasts and independent media as the Nation's salvation: just a year ago when they helped Trump win.

Now many of those podcasters criticize Israel and Trump's captivity to it, so now they're poison. Must trust corporate media again.


Lydia Moynihan (@LydiaMoynihan)

Podcasting began as a way to counter mainstream media… now it’s resulted in questioning everything from the moon landing to the holocaust

In the wake of the 2013 Snowden reporting, the House had a bill co-sponsored by John Conyers (D-MI) and Justin Amash (R-MI) to rein in NSA spying on Americans. It was on its way to passage-- the first time since 9/11 USG powers would have been reduced -- but Obama got Nancy Pelosi to whip Dem votes against it, and so it failed by a few votes.

Since then, Mike Johnson and now the Congressional Black Congress have acted to ensure that the NSA's domestic spying powers under FISA 702 continue with
